## Summary

Describe the scenario, what changed, and how it helps the community.

## Change type

- [ ] New sample
- [ ] Existing sample update
- [ ] Gallery or documentation improvement

## Sample or pages affected

Include the sample folder or the gallery pages changed. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the prerequisites, commands run, and results. For a sample, confirm that you
tested the documented setup and usage from a clean checkout. For gallery changes,
include type-check, build, and relevant output/browser test results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] This PR is focused; a new sample submission contains only one sample and its root README table entry.
- [ ] Documentation, screenshots, and alternative text match the behavior.
- [ ] I have permission to share the source and assets, and have removed secrets and tenant-specific IDs.
- [ ] I will complete the Contributor License Agreement check if requested.

### Sample changes only

Skip this section for gallery-only or documentation-only changes.

- [ ] I used the correct sample prefix and project template where one is available.
- [ ] The sample includes complete source, README, metadata, local screenshots, and toolchain-appropriate ignore/environment examples.
- [ ] `assets/sample.json` includes accurate authors, dates, and image thumbnails.
- [ ] No template placeholders, placeholder images, `projectId`, or packaged `.zip` archives remain.
- [ ] The sample uses the latest published manifest schemas and the correct `additionalMetadata.sampleTag` where applicable.
- [ ] The sample-root README ends with the view tracker matching its exact repository-relative sample path.
- [ ] A new sample is listed in the root README samples table.
